machuca-wikipedia-omit.notes: No substantive English Wikipedia article exists for Machuca, the Atacama altiplano hamlet (Antofagasta Region, Chile). The only en.wikipedia.org page under that title is the 2004 Chilean film directed by Andrés Wood. No English-language article covering the village as a place exists; the Spanish-language article es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machuca_(localidad) covers the locality but this guide links English Wikipedia only.
